summary: Toole County, Montana cabin site on private cooperator land, about 31 miles northeast of Shelby; dated to the 1930s, abandoned, now gone.

facts.design: cabin at ground level (not a tower)
facts.status_note: Gone. Abandoned; no source describes what remains.

evidence.supports: cooperator is private; township 35N, range 3E, section 22

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Both firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say the land is private cooperator land, Toole County, 1930s cabin, abandoned. The FFLA list gives type Ground and status Gone, and its coordinates match the record's point. No year is given beyond the decade, so no events are listed. The record's agency field reads Private; it is an ownership label, so facts.agency says Private cooperator. A search result for Gold Butte, about 32 miles northeast of Shelby in the Sweet Grass Hills, is a different site and was not used. Nothing read gives present-day condition or public access. No photos added.
